text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum♪
I can't wait for the movie!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's talking about how it's an "ultra-complex mystery," after all!
An ending you could never predict... I wonder what it's like~!

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like the doors opened! Come on you two, let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder who the culprit is~☆ When I saw the trailer,
I thought maybe the chef...? But...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Because it's 'completely unpredictable'!
I'm sure it'll be something else, right? Can't wait~!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man!
The culprit really was the chef~~!!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"No way? I thought it was totally unexpected!
That trick using the cake was amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That cake looked delicious, didn't it~!
Since we're here, let's grab some tea after this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmph... Maya's going home then~.
That was kinda disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, isn't there anything
more thrilling out there~?
Looking thoroughly dejected, Mayano Top Gun headed back home...
